ideas.pitch: An AI-powered startup pitch deck analyzer and valuation predictor trained on historical funding rounds, designed specifically to help student founders vet their readiness for VC scrutiny.
ideas.title: VentureScout AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since VentureX features VCs in the Grand Finale and focuses heavily on pitching, a tool that helps founders optimize their pitch decks using data-driven forecasting will directly appeal to the judging panel's core interests.

ideas.pitch: Automated regulatory compliance and land use monitoring platform for Indian startups, utilizing satellite imagery to flag industrial zoning issues before they hit due diligence.
ideas.title: ComplianceGuard India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of solving genuinely hard engineering problems and targets the commercial due diligence pain points that judges and VCs care about during startup vetting.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace that connects early-stage student founders with micro-grants and incubator programs, featuring automated application tracking and milestone reporting.
ideas.title: FundFlow Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds upon proven autonomous agent architectures while directly addressing the incubation and entrepreneurship mission of the EIC organizing body.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined graph-intelligence platform for early-stage fintech startups in India to run automated anti-money laundering risk checks and transaction monitoring.
ideas.title: RiskLens AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mimics a hackathon-winning architecture by combining graph intelligence and explainable risk scoring, which heavily impresses technical judges looking for robust backend engineering.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered financial health and nutrition tracker tailored for local Indian micro-enterprises to optimize cash flow and operational spending in real time.
ideas.title: SME-HealthMetrics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts proven consumer wellness AI patterns into B2B financial metrics, providing a tangible product prototype that business and investor judges can instantly evaluate for market viability.
